fix: Read the leading '(3 or)' as the lower extreme (value_min_extreme 3) and '4 or 5' as the usual range 4-5. Use the count pattern (03), with PO 'calyx lobe' as the bearer instead of sepal. The same applies to 'stamens (3 or)4 or 5'.

target: falling = deciduous (shed early); add a rule to PATO:0001730 deciduous (generic) for stipules, bracts and other parts
fix: Add a word rule 'falling' / 'falling early' -> PATO:0001730. No new class is needed.

fix: Add a reviewed bearer table for the numbered spikelet 'scales' of NAF grasses (Paniceae): first scale = PO:0006002 lower glume, second scale = PO:0006004 upper glume, third scale = PO:0009040 sterile lemma. Then split 'the second and third scales 3-nerved' into two counts of 3 veins, one per part.

fix: Treat the privative prefix 'e-' (eglandular, epapillate, ebracteate) as a negation cue inside the word, with the offsets of the whole word. Or add a rule: eglandular -> negated PATO:0002117 glandular.

fix: Add rows 'sect' / 'sected' -> lobe (segment) to config/flora_counted_parts.tsv, as already exists for 'partite'. This gives a count of 5 calyx lobes. Keep 'from base' (cut to the base) as source text.
reason: '5-sect' is a compound count word like '5-partite'. Its ending is just missing from the table.

fix: Add the cue 'N or more' (also 'or longer' / 'or taller'), placed after the value, as an inclusive lower bound: value_low 1, unit dm, value_high null.
reason: This is a lower bound written after the number. The cue list only has 'more than' placed before the value.

fix: Bearer = the counted part (here PO:0025331 ray flower), quality = amount PATO:0000070, value = a reviewed FLOPO value class 'numerous' (many / indefinite) or 'few' under amount, with no numeric data range. OWL: has part some (ray flower and has characteristic some numerous). RDF keeps the word as cue.
reason: Pattern 03 deliberately holds counts without a number ('few', 'many'). 'Numerous' is very common in floras and needs a qualitative count value.

fix: Normalise the OCR '|' -> 's' before transcribing. 'slender or stout' is then an ordinary alternative (07a) of stem thickness.
reason: The quality phrase holds an OCR artefact, so its second value cannot ground.

fix: As in P01166: bearer leaf, bearer_context_qualities basal FLOPO:0991002 (pattern 04), quality amount PATO:0000070 with the FLOPO value 'numerous'.
reason: Same construction: a count given by 'numerous' instead of a number.

fix: Add a rule: a count of 0 becomes absence, i.e. ray flower PO:0025331 with absent PATO:0000462 (or negated present) in the head. Ignore the parenthesised '(pistillate)' as a gloss. The transcribed quality 'ray florets present' is wrong.

fix: Read 'with N <part>' when the part grounds: bearer fruit locule PO:0025270, container fruit (the organ of the clause), amount = 4, unit count.
reason: This is a plain count of parts. Only the 'with 4 locules' wording is not read.

fix: Bearer stamen (antepetalous = opposite PATO:0001933 towards petal, as context), quality distance PATO:0000040 with magnitude 1 mm (value_qualifier approximately for 'ca.') towards PO:0025146 petal base. OWL: has characteristic some (distance and towards some petal base), with the number in the data range. RDF keeps 'inserted ... from'.

fix: Bearer pinnule, quality in contact with PATO:0001961 towards pinnule (the neighbouring members of the same series). Allow target = bearer class only for a reviewed list of mutual words (contiguous, overlapping, distant, remote).
reason: The second term is not missing: it is the neighbouring pinnules. The 2026-11-13 rejection (C246) covered contiguous with no target. The SPARQL rule relation_target_is_not_the_bearer currently blocks this reading.

fix: Bearer lateral vein (secondary vein), quality angle PATO:0002326 towards midvein, with an upper bound of 45 degrees (strict, 'less than'), frequency_qualifier usually. OWL: has part some (vein and has characteristic some (angle and towards some midvein)) plus the data range.

fix: Split 'compressed-obovoid' into two values of the same bearer that both hold: flattened (PATO) and obovoid FLOPO:0991025. OWL: an intersection of two has characteristic restrictions, not a continuum. 'broadly' stays as a source modifier. A hyphen is read as a conjunction when the first member is a modifier of another attribute (compressed, depressed, broadly).
reason: This is not an alternative or a continuum: the seed is both compressed and obovoid. The hyphen-as-continuum reading does not fit here.

fix: Scope the context cue to the comma segment instead of the clause. 'abaxially' occurs twice in the sentence ('midrib abaxially elevated'), so the uniqueness rule rejects it. Annotate leaf lamina abaxial epidermis + pubescent, and the hair colour (yellowish brown) on the trichome.

target: not opening widely = flower only partly open at anthesis (half-open)
fix: Map to PATO:0000610 open with a reviewed qualifier 'partly' (pattern 01 has no such qualifier yet), or add a FLOPO value 'partly open' under open.

fix: Add a bearer rule: 'wings' in a papilionaceous corolla (next to standard and keel) -> PO:0025325 wing petal. The target 'standard' already grounds to PO:0025324 banner petal. Result: decreased length PATO:0000574 towards banner petal.

target: liana = woody climbing plant; rule to FLOPO:0991108 climbing (plus woody) on whole plant
fix: Give the FLOPO 'liana' phenotype the signature whole plant + FLOPO:0991108 climbing (+ woody). Or add a word rule 'liana' / 'lianescent' -> climbing.

fix: Accept 'to ± N' as an approximate upper bound (value_qualifier approximately, frequency usually). Put 'one specimen seen to 12 mm' in value_max_extreme (pattern 05). Ground the bearer 'rays' of an umbel (inflorescence branch).

fix: Bearer lenticel PO:0000031, quality amount with the FLOPO value 'numerous'. 'nombreuses' should be a French synonym of the same value.

fix: 'paler beneath' implies the target. Bearer = abaxial epidermis of the leaflet (from 'beneath'), quality = a lightness quality towards the adaxial epidermis of the same organ, frequency_qualifier often. OWL: has characteristic some (Q and towards some adaxial epidermis).

fix: Read 'at base' as the region cue (it is in the table), not as a relation. Use the rule narrowed -> tapered PATO:0001500 (C172), with bearer PO:0008019 leaf lamina base.

target: entity rosette PO:0025615, quality diameter PATO:0001334

fix: Add the rule '3-lobed' -> PATO:0002241 trilobed. Pattern 03 says the word stays a quality where a rule exists, so it should not be read as a measurement without a unit.

fix: Transcribe 'nearly glabrous' as glabrous + nearly, with 'nearly' as the cue. It is not a negated 'pubescent'.

fix: Spread the shared target 'than culm' over both comparatives. Make a union (07a, attribute length) of decreased length PATO:0000574 and increased length PATO:0000573, both towards stem PO:0009047 (culm is a synonym); 'slightly' kept as source text.
